title: `@tauri-apps/cli` has un-declared dependencies

labels.name: help wanted
labels.description: Help is requested to fix this issue

body:
### **Describe the bug**
When running under yarn with PNP & trying to use the `tauri icon` command I get the following error:

```
 λ yarn tauri icon --log --icon ~/Downloads/icon.png --compression="zopfli"
[tauri]: running icon
(node:136357) UnhandledPromiseRejectionWarning: Error: @tauri-apps/cli tried to access graceful-fs, but it isn't declared in its dependencies; this makes the require call ambiguous and unsound.

Required package: graceful-fs
Required by: @tauri-apps/cli@npm:1.0.0-beta.6 (via …/.yarn/unplugged/@tauri-apps-cli-npm-1.0.0-beta.6-ae47f770e1/node_modules/@tauri-apps/cli/dist/api/)
```

### **Platform and Versions (required):**
```
app:spawn Running "…/.yarn/unplugged/@tauri-apps-cli-npm-1.0.0-beta.6-ae47f770e1/node_modules/@tauri-apps/cli/bin/tauri-cli tauri info" +0ms

Operating System - Ubuntu, version 21.04 X64

Node.js environment
  Node.js - 14.17.0
  @tauri-apps/cli - 1.0.0-beta.6
  @tauri-apps/api - Not installed

Global packages
  npm - 6.14.13
  yarn - 3.0.0-rc.12.git.20210720.hash-0bb4746e

Rust environment
  rustc - 1.53.0
  cargo - 1.53.0

App directory structure
/src
/src-tauri

App
  tauri.rs - 1.0.0-beta.5
  build-type - bundle
  CSP - default-src blob: data: filesystem: ws: wss: http: https: tauri: 'unsafe-eval' 'unsafe-inline' 'self' img-src: 'self'
  distDir - ../../../build/js/bundle/toolbox
  devPath - http://localhost:3000
  framework - React
```

### **Additional context**
- https://classic.yarnpkg.com/en/docs/pnp/troubleshooting/#toc-is-trying-to-require-without-it-being-listed-in-its-dependencies
